gloss: good match; advantageous marriage; fortunate connection

definitions.gloss: good match; advantageous marriage; fortunate connection
definitions.explanation: A fortunate or desirable connection, especially in the context of marriage. Can also refer to a beneficial relationship or encounter in a broader sense.

examples.japanese: {良縁|りょうえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧。
examples.english: To be blessed with a good match.
I hope my daughter finds a good match.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{良縁|りょうえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御利益|ごりやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: That shrine is said to bring blessings for finding a good partner.

notes:
Composed of {良|りょう} (good) + ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ (fate, connection, bond). Primarily refers to a desirable marriage partner or marital match, but can extend to any fortunate encounter or connection. Rooted in the Japanese concept of ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ — the idea that meaningful relationships are shaped by fate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良縁|りょうえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧: to be blessed with a good match
- {良縁|りょうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧: to pray for a good match
- {良縁|りょうえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御利益|ごりやく}: blessings for finding a good partner
- {良縁|りょうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to form a good connection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縁談|えんだん}→縁談：13847_endan⟧: marriage proposal / match arrangement — the concrete process of arranging a marriage
- ⟦{縁結|えんむす}び→縁結び：14781_enmusubi⟧: matchmaking — the act of bringing people together, often associated with shrines
- {悪縁|あくえん}: bad connection — an unfortunate or harmful relationship; the opposite of {良縁|りょうえん}

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese shrines are known as ⟦{縁結|えんむす}び→縁結び：14781_enmusubi⟧ (matchmaking) shrines where visitors pray for {良縁|りょうえん}. Famous examples include ⟦{出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}→出雲大社：29110_izumotaisha⟧ in Shimane and {東京大神宮|とうきょうだいじんぐう} in Tokyo.
